purpose: Test whether five compact causal entry detectors identify usable long moves with high target-first precision, explicit coverage, structural invalidation, and positive cost-adjusted dynamic payoff without using regimes or loops.

opened_data_status.portability_period_warning: Both periods have participated elsewhere in the research lineage. Freezing this detector family prevents further outcome tuning but does not make either period prospective validation.
opened_data_status.aal_2026_reason: Three terminal AAL OHLC rows were exposed during the timestamp/schema seal audit before this contract was written.

data.off_grid_policy: Rows not exactly on a five-minute boundary, including nonzero seconds, are excluded and counted; they are never rounded or coerced.
data.volume_use: Only detector H5 may use current completed-bar historical volume relative to the prior six completed bars.

causal_clock.decision: A detector may use only the completed decision bar and earlier contiguous completed bars from the same regular session.
causal_clock.admission: Hypothetical admission is the exact next five-minute provider open.
causal_clock.entry_open: The next open becomes available only at admission; it may determine causal risk eligibility but not whether the prior detector fired.
causal_clock.outcome: Future highs, lows, closes, target/stop hits, MFE, MAE, and fixed-horizon returns are forbidden until the pre-outcome event ledger is hashed.
causal_clock.expiry: Twenty-four exact contiguous bars beginning with the admission bar.
causal_clock.late_session: Decision bar ordinal must be no greater than 53 so the full 24-bar regular-session window is scheduled to exist.
causal_clock.gaps: Any non-five-minute gap, including an excluded off-grid row, starts a new causal segment. Rows lacking an exact future path are skipped and counted.
causal_clock.cooldown: Within each symbol, session, and detector, no new event may fire for 24 decision bars after an emitted event.
causal_clock.execution: Research counterfactual only; no order or position exists.

shared_features.prior_scale_bps: median true_range_bps of the prior 12 contiguous bars, excluding the decision bar
shared_features.prior_12_low: minimum low of the prior 12 contiguous bars, excluding the decision bar
shared_features.opening_range_low: minimum low of exact session ordinals 0 through 5
shared_features.relative_activity_6: current positive finite historical_volume divided by the geometric mean of the prior six positive finite completed-bar values

detectors.origin: Frozen from the opened 2024 raw-OHLC long-reversal lead; portability only.
detectors.expected_benefit: Detect exhaustion after a downside expansion without a fitted model.
detectors.safety_risk: The mechanism was seeded by opened 2024 outcomes and cannot be called validation.
detectors.stop_condition: Reject unless every high-accuracy and economic gate passes in both portability periods.

detectors.origin: Classic failed-breakout mechanism selected before portability scoring.
conditions: decision low is at least 0.10 prior_scale_bps below prior_12_low
detectors.expected_benefit: Require an observable sweep and reclaim rather than infer exhaustion from a fitted score.
detectors.safety_risk: A tiny breach or same-bar target/stop ambiguity could overstate reversal quality; both are handled conservatively.
detectors.stop_condition: Reject unless every high-accuracy and economic gate passes in both portability periods.

detectors.origin: Confirmation-stage variant of the opened downside-expansion hypothesis.
conditions: prior bar satisfies the H1 range, body, and close-location conditions using its own lagged scale
decision bar closes above the prior bar midpoint
detectors.invalidation: minimum low of the expansion and confirmation bars
detectors.expected_benefit: Trade coverage for cleaner confirmation and reduce immediate adverse paths.
detectors.safety_risk: Confirmation may enter after the usable reversal has already occurred.
detectors.stop_condition: Reject unless every high-accuracy and economic gate passes in both portability periods.

detectors.origin: Opening-range failed-breakout family with the early-session clue frozen before portability scoring.
conditions: decision low is at least 0.10 prior_scale_bps below opening_range_low
detectors.expected_benefit: Detect an early-session failed downside auction at a meaningful session level.
detectors.safety_risk: The early-session emphasis was observed after opened 2024 analysis.
detectors.stop_condition: Reject unless every high-accuracy and economic gate passes in both portability periods.

detectors.origin: Frozen activity-timing variant of H1; the 1.10 ratio is a post-inspection 2024 hypothesis.
detectors.expected_benefit: Test historical activity as movement timing after price supplies direction.
detectors.safety_risk: Historical provider volume is only an activity proxy and the threshold is opened-data-derived.
detectors.stop_condition: Reject unless every high-accuracy and economic gate passes in both portability periods.

risk_and_outcome.target: entry_open plus one structural risk distance
risk_and_outcome.target_first_success: Target is touched before stop within 24 bars.
risk_and_outcome.same_bar_dual_touch: Conservative stop-first failure because intrabar OHLC order is unknown.
risk_and_outcome.open_gap_rule: Admission-bar and later opens beyond target or stop establish that side first; an open cannot be beyond both.
risk_and_outcome.no_touch: Exit at the close of bar 24.
risk_and_outcome.clean_success_secondary: target_first and target reached within six bars and pre-target MAE <= 0.50R
risk_and_outcome.excursions: MFE, MAE, time-to-MFE, time-to-MAE, target/stop time, and pre-target MAE are outcome-only.

matched_control.eligibility: same symbol, period, month, long direction, clock bucket, exact 24-bar path, and not a detector event for that family
matched_control.selection: deterministic nearest prior_scale_bps with SHA-256 tie-break, without reading future outcomes
matched_control.risk: copy the detector event risk_bps symmetrically around the control next-open entry
matched_control.reuse: forbidden within detector family and period

accuracy_definition.primary: target-first precision among every emitted event; stop-first, dual-touch ambiguity, and no-touch all count as failures
accuracy_definition.coverage: events per 10,000 eligible decision anchors plus sessions and stocks represented
accuracy_definition.accuracy_warning: A detector cannot qualify by abstaining almost everywhere, by reporting resolved paths only, or by ignoring costs.

evaluation.multiplicity: Separate Holm families across all five detectors and both periods for target-first precision lift and absolute dynamic net payoff.
qualification_gates: minimum event and stock support in both periods
95 percent session-block lower precision bound >= 0.55 in both periods
precision lift over matched controls >= 0.05 with lower bound > 0 and Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05 in both periods
mean dynamic net payoff > 0 with lower bound > 0 and Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05 at 5 bps per side in both periods
mean dynamic net payoff remains positive at 7.5 bps per side in both periods
positive dynamic net payoff in a majority of calendar months in both periods
positive dynamic net payoff and precision lift in at least 16 of 20 leave-one-stock-out deletions for 2025 and 15 of 19 for 2026
descriptive_only: MFE, MAE, timing, and path efficiency

forbidden: regime, state, loop, cycle, child, morph, template, B0, or realised route inputs
future OHLCV, future state, future duration, target, stop, MFE, MAE, or payoff in detector conditions
selecting a detector, threshold, risk band, horizon, target, stop, session window, or cost from portability outcomes
dropping ambiguous, no-touch, losing, or low-confidence emitted events from precision
promoting any finding to live, paper, demo, broker, deployment, position, order, or application functionality
